cuts.reason: Cuts from the single unbroken kitchen shot straight to the black end card right after the punchline line 'the cabinets are paying for it,' giving the joke no visual distraction and landing on the show's branding immediately after the laugh line.

pacing_notes: The entire joke runs as one uncut, static two-shot of the wife and low-battery husband for ~13s (almost the whole runtime), with all comedic timing carried by dialogue and the husband's frozen/glitchy posture rather than by editing. There is no coverage cutting, no cutaways, and no reaction shots. The only cut in the piece is the final hard cut from that single shot to a ~0.6s black title/outro card ('Low Battery People, created by Nin, New Episode Daily'), so pacing is essentially flat and dialogue-driven throughout, then snaps abruptly to branding at the very end.
